title: Beşiktaş Defeats Kocaelispor and Eyes Clash with Trabzonspor
seoTitle: Beşiktaş Beats Kocaelispor Ahead of Trabzonspor Clash
subtitle: Home victory keeps the team unbeaten ahead of their duel with Trabzonspor
excerpt: In Süper Lig matchday 7, Beşiktaş beat Kocaelispor 3-1 with goals from Orkun Kökçü, Vaclav Cerny, and Dusan Vlahovic, heading into their next match.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In round seven of the Süper Lig, Beşiktaş hosted Kocaelispor at Çamlıca Stadium and walked away with all three points, keeping their unbeaten streak alive ahead of facing Trabzonspor next week.

Beşiktaş pushes for home victory

Selçuk İnan's side took the pitch aiming to maintain the undefeated run built across the first six matches, which yielded four wins and two losses. The manager emphasized the importance of closing out the match without dropping points to secure their spot near the top of the table.

Goals and key moments

Beşiktaş's first goal came in the 18th minute, when Orkun Kökçü received a pass from Vaclav Cerny and produced a precise finish to put the team ahead. Kocaelispor responded in the 27th minute, with Show scoring from an Uğur Kaan Yıldız cross to level the score. Beşiktaş regained the lead in the 31st minute, when Dusan Vlahovic converted a penalty awarded after Tayfur Bingöl fouled Tiago Djalo. The final score stood at 3-1.

Injured player updates

Milot Rashica, who suffered an injury to his right inner thigh, missed the match and will remain sidelined for about a month. Captain Orkun Kökçü entered the game carrying a yellow card and risks suspension if booked again in the clash against Trabzonspor.

Implications for the next round

With the win, Beşiktaş reaches 12 points and holds onto third place on goal difference. The team remains unbeaten at home, having won all seven matches played at the "Dolmabahçe" stadium this season. Their next challenge will be against Trabzonspor, where another yellow card could sideline Kökçü, forcing a shift in the manager's strategy.

With information from Habertürk.
